messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] PROD: spike in 5xx + gateway timeouts on /v1/chat/stream (us-east-1, eu-central). 10m error-rate 9.6% (baseline 0.2%). Paging maria (oncall). Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/kv-prefix-evictions

maria (oncall): on it. getting initial dashboards. Any known deploys at ~16:00 UTC?

ops-bot: Deploy event: rollout(prefetch-v2) started by olga at 16:01:02 UTC, canary 10% -> 100% in 4m.

vikas (eng-sre): I see a correlated jump in prefix-kv eviction rate and backing-store IO. Many sequential evictions on shards 7-9 starting 16:03. Cache miss rate up x18. Some nodes report index validation failures: 
```
2026-03-15T16:04:11Z ERROR prefix-kv[shard-8] validate_index: checksum mismatch key_prefix="u:chat:session:..." id=0x7fae3
2026-03-15T16:04:12Z WARN eviction-controller cascade_eviction count=632 in 12s
```

olga (eng-runtime): Confirmed prefetch-v2 changed eviction scoring and aggressive prefetch for high-cardinality prefixes. It rolled to 100% at 16:05. Looks like prefetch created many transient entries which pushed memory pressure and triggered cascade evictions; some shards hit a bug path where partial writes led to checksum errors.

kevin (support): Support queue: customers hitting streaming disconnects and 502s. High-priority: SummitHealth and BetaForge are affected; SummitHealth reported timeouts in production workflows. They're asking for ETA and mitigation plan.

maria (oncall): proposed immediate actions (live):
- flip prefetch-v2 off globally
- enable disk-read fallthrough on checksum mismatch (fail-open)
- scale up shard mem limits for hot shards and pin them to node pool with spare capacity
- route top 5 customers to dedicated non-prefetch pool (manual route)

Commands I'm executing now: 
```
# disable prefetch-v2
curl -s -X POST https://flags.ops/set -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS" -d '{"flag":"prefetch_v2","value":false}'
# enable fail-open disk read
curl -s -X POST https://flags.ops/set -d '{"flag":"kv_checksum_fail_open","value":true}'
# bump shard mem
shardctl update --shard=8 --max-mem=56G
```

vikas (eng-sre): I'm kicking off rolling restarts for shards 7-9 with repair-scan enabled. Plan: drain -> restart -> index-scan -> rejoin. Stagger by 90s to avoid cluster-wide thrash.

olga (eng-runtime): Increasing gateway->worker read timeout from 20s to 40s temporarily to reduce mid-stream 502s. Also enabling worker-level disk cache for prefix misses so we serve slightly older entries if live cache unreadable.

kevin (support): Update: SummitHealth acknowledged mitigation plan and asked to be routed to a dedicated pool ASAP. Tori, can you help coordinate comms and offer an interim workaround?

tori (customer-success): drafting message: brief root-cause, mitigation steps taken, ETA for recovery, and we’ll post to status.redwood.ai. Prioritizing SummitHealth and BetaForge.

ops-bot: Flag toggles applied: prefetch_v2=false at 16:07:31 UTC; kv_checksum_fail_open=true at 16:07:33 UTC.

vikas (eng-sre): Metrics: error-rate peaked 11.0% at 16:06. After quick flag flip and first shard restart started at 16:08, error-rate down to 4.8% at 16:13. Miss-rate still elevated for some user-key prefixes.

olga (eng-runtime): shard-8 restart logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T16:12:58Z] INFO shard-8 - drain started
[2026-03-15T16:14:11Z] INFO shard-8 - restart complete; index-scan found 412 partial-writes; repaired 412 entries via snapshot-apply
[2026-03-15T16:14:15Z] INFO shard-8 - rejoin complete
```

maria (oncall): routing: SummitHealth moved to dedicated pool at 16:16; BetaForge at 16:17. Observability: tail latency for seq_len>6k still higher than baseline; watching.

kevin (support): customers confirm reduced errors after routing; SummitHealth reports restored workflows. Good initial response.

vikas (eng-sre): Next actions (post-stabilization):
- revert prefetch-v2 and rework heuristic: cap prefetch candidates per-tenant, avoid high-cardinality wildcard prefetch
- add a guardrail alert: if sequential-evictions-per-sec > 100 for any shard for 10s, trigger auto-disable of prefetch and page SRE
- implement checksum-failover to disk-read as permanent safe-default to avoid throwing 5xx on minor corruption
- run full index-integrity sweep across cluster during low-traffic window

olga (eng-runtime): Additional: create canary strategy for prefetch-v2 with traffic-weighted seq_len sampling, and automatic rollback when eviction metric delta > 2x within 5m. Also add per-tenant seq_len limit and early-reject paths for unrealistic sequences from partners.

maria (oncall): status update: error-rate 0.9% at 16:28, timeouts down. Marking incident as mitigated (degraded). Will handoff to night oncall in 30m. Postmortem owner: vikas.

tori (customer-success): will send follow-up to impacted customers in 45m with incident summary and link to postmortem once available.

maria (oncall): final summary for thread: root cause = prefetch-v2 rollout + sudden high-cardinality prefetch + traffic spike -> eviction cascade -> partial writes leading to checksum mismatches -> increased 5xx/timeouts. Live mitigations = disable prefetch, enable checksum fail-open, shard mem bump, rolling restarts with repairs, route critical customers to dedicated pool, increase timeouts. Postmortem and long-term guardrails captured. closing thread as "mitigated (degraded)" unless we see reversion. :white_check_mark:
